GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, rider advised that with the blinkers removed for today’s race the mare began only fairly, did not respond to her urgings early and settled further back than anticipated and thereafter raced disinterestedly and proved very disappointing in its failure to respond to her riding in the straight. A post-race vet exam of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.
